title: Star trails over El Capitan
alt: Circular star trails above the dark outline of El Capitan, with climbers' headlamps dotting the wall.

title: Poppy and lupine hillside
alt: A hillside of orange poppies and purple lupine, with one small seated figure near the top.

title: El Capitan in storm clouds
alt: Black and white view of El Capitan's granite face with storm cloud and mist drifting through the pines below.

title: Orchestra under the organ
alt: An orchestra and conductor perform on a dim stage beneath a large ornate pipe organ in a wood-paneled hall.

title: Light trail, night boulder
alt: A figure stands on a lit boulder in a dark canyon under stars, beside a wavy white trail of light.

title: El Capitan in evening light
alt: El Capitan's sheer granite face glows orange in evening light above a forested valley floor and meadow.

title: Carrying the tray
alt: Two shirtless men carry a wooden tray across a lawn under a pink and orange sunset sky framed by palms.

title: Climber on granite
alt: A tiny climber in red hangs on a vast streaked granite wall in shades of tan and gray.

title: Bouldering with a spotter
alt: A woman in a gray fleece climbs an overhanging rock while a man below raises a hand to spot her.

title: Blue domes in Oia
alt: Two blue church domes and a white bell tower above whitewashed buildings and the deep blue caldera.

title: Hula at sunset
alt: Hula dancers in red dresses perform in silhouette beneath tall palms against an orange and purple sunset.

title: El Capitan in side light
alt: Close view of El Capitan's upper face, its granite ridges lit gold by low side light against blue sky.

title: Facing a snowy peak
alt: A lone figure seen from behind stands between granite boulders looking toward a snow-covered mountain peak.

title: Tunnel View in mist
alt: Yosemite Valley under low grey cloud, El Capitan on the left and Half Dome fading into mist.

title: Cathedral Spires in monochrome
alt: Black and white view of two granite spires and a dark cliff edge against a pale overcast sky.

title: Climber from above
alt: Top-down view of a helmeted climber on a lichen-covered rock face, rope coiled on the ground far below.

title: Friends hugging below snowy peaks
alt: Two laughing friends in a tight hug on a dry plain with snow-covered mountains under a blue sky.

title: Treasury of the Athenians
alt: Small Doric stone treasury with two columns, tall cypresses and a deep blue sky behind it.

title: Treasury from above
alt: Stone treasury seen from a hillside path above, with a wide green valley and hazy mountains beyond.

title: Temple terrace under cliffs
alt: Ruined temple platform and scattered stones below steep limestone cliffs, framed by an overhanging tree branch.

title: Temple of Apollo columns
alt: Weathered standing columns on a stone platform beside dark cypress trees under a pale blue sky.

title: Orange church with blue dome
alt: Orange-painted church with a blue dome and bell tower set against a clear, pale blue sky.

title: Caldera cliffs and town
alt: White cliffside town strung along steep volcanic cliffs dropping into the deep blue caldera sea.

title: Oia on the cliff edge
alt: White cave houses and terraces stepping down a cliff, with the caldera and distant island in haze.

title: Stairway toward the sea
alt: Narrow stone stairway between orange and white walls descending toward a dark blue sea with distant ships.

title: Procession with leis
alt: Two shirtless performers in white leis carrying a platter across a lawn at dusk under purple sky and palms.

title: Tree row in evening light
alt: Row of broad umbrella-shaped trees lit gold on a green lawn below cloud-capped hills.

title: Quizzical look
alt: Mustached man in a patterned shirt raising a brow at the camera under a dark blue canopy.

title: Toast with a red drink
alt: Red-haired young man grinning and raising a small glass of red drink toward the camera.

title: Seated under a hazy moon
alt: Young man in a white shirt sitting on top of a truck at night, a haloed moon above him.

title: Young surfers heading out
alt: Young surfers in wetsuits and contest jerseys walking across the sand toward the waves carrying boards.

title: Yellow wildflower on blue
alt: Single yellow wildflower and buds on a thin stem, isolated against a smooth deep blue background.
